fit_reason: Whole car (1985 Corvette C4) listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Red paint on the hood and front bumper looks dull and slightly faded, with light spotting and specks on the lower nose
Dust and grime on the engine bay surfaces, intake runners and plastic covers
Dusty, faded engine bay sheet metal and inner fender areas around the air intake
Black rubber/trim strip along the front bumper and door top looks faded and dry
Dust and light marks on the red interior door panel and lower door jamb area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 85 Corvette. The red paint on the hood and nose looks a bit dull in the photos, and the engine bay and door panels have some dust that cleans up well. We do mobile pre-sale details including a machine buff and polish, and we can come to you. Would you like a quote?
